metadata.name: elohim-project
metadata.description: Shared project MCP registrations for Claude Code and Codex, plus the Codex project-doc instruction budget. project_doc_max_bytes = 65536: Codex's default combined AGENTS.md budget is 32768 B, which truncated our 42327-byte root gospel mid-line; measured 42327 + >=50% headroom = 63490.5, rounded up to the next power-of-two KiB = 65536 (1.548x the root, 23209 B left for the subtree AGENTS.md files the root restructure will add). Mitigation, not cure - the monolith still wants splitting.
